synopsis: Marionette is a world model that predicts 3D scene state (skeletons, trajectories) and uses a zero-parameter renderer for geometry before a diffusion model generates appearance, enabling structured interactive game simulation.

The paper proposes a structured evidence tuple (hypothesis, reliability, rationale, provenance) and argues that evidence should be combined using calibrated log-likelihood ratios instead of summation to avoid count-scale drift in decision aggregation.

Rollplex is a runtime system that overlaps prefix computation with rollout decoding to improve GPU utilization during Vision-Language Model post-training, enabling more efficient spatial sharing of GPU resources across phases.
The Twin system builds a test-time executable world model for unknown tasks by simulating interactions and repairing discrepancies, enabling continual learning without prior task knowledge.
YOPO combines conditional reasoning guidance and zero-shot abstention into one forward pass of a frozen language model, allowing it to answer or decline in a single inference step.
GhostPoint is a self-supervised learning framework for 3D object detection that hallucinates features for occluded LiDAR regions using predictor-level supervision and instance voxel dilation.

The paper introduces Generation-Powered Inference (GPI), a framework that uses generative models to reframe statistical inference on distribution-valued outcomes as mean function estimation in a Hilbert space.

SheetCompass is an agentic framework that enhances LLM reasoning over spreadsheets by modeling hierarchical relationships and spatial context across worksheets.

SimpleOPD is a tokenizer-agnostic on-policy distillation method for transferring reasoning from long-context teacher models to short-context student models by aligning identical text spans and adding a student reference KL loss to control output length.
